import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_53/test_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes from all sources
dfs = []

# Load each source file
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all source dataframes (if multiple)
all_data = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Group by 'continent' and aggregate the numeric columns by mean
# This matches the target schema and example aggregation style
target_df = all_data.groupby('continent', as_index=False).agg({
    'beer_servings': 'mean',
    'spirit_servings': 'mean',
    'wine_servings': 'mean',
    'total_litres_of_pure_alcohol': 'mean'
})

# Ensure the column order matches the target schema exactly
target_df = target_df[['continent', 'beer_servings', 'spirit_servings', 'wine_servings', 'total_litres_of_pure_alcohol']]

# Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_53/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
